column1: # Consolidated planner-bound typed join runtime evidence.

column5: The live LEFT path accumulates TRUE FALSE UNKNOWN through the canonical OuterRowStatus priority and finalization authority, so only a TRUE candidate suppresses null extension; hash-build-side used flags, batch caches, and spill scanning remain open.

Scalar and reusable batch masks retain disjoint TRUE and UNKNOWN state, while the live join path consumes the same tri-state evaluator; Go vectorized expression kernels, chunk selection restoration, and pooled zero slices remain open.

Qualified and globally unique columns bind against source-ordered FullSchema before execution, including redundant USING-side visibility; full expression-rewriter pooling, correlated subqueries, casts, and generated-column rewrites remain open.

Residual column dependencies, including nested IN BETWEEN LIKE IS CASE and CAST shapes, bind to deterministic FullSchema indexes before typed execution; query-bearing and unsupported fulltext shapes are rejected before row evaluation, while physical index ranges and access/remained split remain open.
